image_description: A silhouette of a large airship (dirigible) flying in the sky during sunset or sunrise. The airship has a classic cigar-shaped envelope with tail fins and a small gondola suspended underneath. Below the airship, the top section of a suspension bridge tower is visible against a cloudy, orange-lit sky. There is a watermark text in the bottom right corner.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the object is taxonomically classified as an airship/dirigible and not a balloon or other aircraft.
To verify the spatial relationship between the airship and the bridge tower, ensuring no geometric melting or impossible occlusion occurs.
To check the boundary sharpness of the airship against the sky, looking for edge bleeding or haloing common in AI generations.
To analyze the legibility and structure of the watermark text, which serves as a strong indicator of real vs. AI-generated imagery (AI often fails at coherent long-form text).

Connection point between gondola and hull
Legibility and coherence of the watermark text
Edge definition against the complex cloud background

Conversely, if the text is gibberish, it indicates AI generation. Also, verify that the bridge tower's geometry is structurally plausible and does not exhibit 'melting' into the clouds.
